create_eval_unit: create a custom EvalUnit subclass that implements prepare_metric_bag and process_batch for model evaluation
run_evaluator: run an Evaluator instance to evaluate a PyTorch model across multiple data readers and eval units
implement_process_batch: implement the process_batch method in an EvalUnit to compute metrics on a single batch
finalize_eval_unit: finalize an EvalUnit by overriding the finalize method to compute final metrics after all batches
request_evaluator_stop: request an Evaluator to stop by calling request_stop to gracefully halt the evaluation loop
